# Georgia Fencing Academy

> Georgia Fencing Academy (GFA) is a fencing club in Marietta, Cobb County, Georgia, in Atlanta's northern suburbs. It teaches foil and épée (epee) fencing at beginner, pre-competitive and competitive level for youth, teens and adults. Head coach: John Terris.

Last updated: 7 October 2026.

## Pages

- Home (about, coach, facility, FAQ, forms, contact): https://georgiafencingacademy.com/
- Adult classes: https://georgiafencingacademy.com/adults/
- Kids and teens classes: https://georgiafencingacademy.com/kids/
- Class schedule and pricing: https://georgiafencingacademy.com/schedule/

## Contact

## Prices

- Single class (drop-in): $35
- Basic plan: $110 per month. Any class except Competitive classes, unlimited open fencing, monthly one-on-one progress session.
- Competitive plan: $175 per month. Every class including Competitive classes, one lesson per week, unlimited open fencing.
- Private lesson: $25 per 20 minutes, by appointment.
- Open fencing strip fee: $25, by appointment. Fencing experience required.
- Competitive classes require a current FIE, AAU, USFA, OGHSFL or GHSFL competitive membership.

## Weekly class schedule

Monday
- 5:30 to 6:30 PM: Épée Youth Pre-competitive (ages 8 to 11)
- 7:00 to 8:30 PM: Épée Beginner / Pre-competitive (ages 12 and up)
- 9:00 to 10:00 PM: Adult Beginner (principles of fencing, basics taught with a foil)

Tuesday
- 6:00 to 7:30 PM: High School and Youth Épée Competitive
- 7:30 to 10:00 PM: Adult Épée Competitive

Wednesday
- 5:30 to 6:30 PM: Épée Youth Pre-competitive (ages 8 to 11)
- 7:00 to 8:30 PM: Épée Beginner / Pre-competitive (ages 12 and up)
- 8:30 to 10:00 PM: Open / Pre-competitive Foil (all ages)

Thursday
- 6:00 to 7:30 PM: High School and Youth Épée Competitive
- 7:30 to 10:00 PM: Adult Épée Competitive

Friday
- 6:30 to 8:00 PM: Focus on Footwork (all levels)
- 8:30 to 10:00 PM: Adult Beginner (principles of fencing, basics taught with a foil)

Saturday
- 11:00 AM to 12:00 PM: Épée Youth Pre-competitive (ages 8 to 11)
- 12:00 to 1:30 PM: Youth Épée Competitive
- 2:30 to 4:00 PM: Foil Competitive (all ages)

Open fencing and private lessons are by appointment on weekday afternoons from 2:00 PM. No classes are scheduled on Sunday.

## Coach

John Terris is head coach, owner and operator. He is a Prévot of foil and épée with the United States Fencing Coaches Association and the Académie d'Armes Internationale, a Moniteur of sabre, and a Level 2 épée coach certified through the USFA Coaches College. He has coached teams at Emory University, Georgia Tech, the University of Georgia, Kennesaw State University, Hollins University, North Gwinnett High School, Lanier High School and Lassiter High School, and is an adjunct fencing instructor at Kennesaw State University.

## First visit

- A first-time fencer does not need to buy anything: all equipment is available at the club. Fencers who intend to compete in local tournaments are expected to buy their own equipment.
- Call 770-366-7633 before a first visit to be pointed to the right class.
- Bring the signed Emergency Contact form: https://georgiafencingacademy.com/docs/emergency-contact-form.pdf
- Bring the signed Accident Waiver and Release of Liability form: https://georgiafencingacademy.com/docs/accident-waiver-liability-form.pdf
